dct_description_sm: Measures of river discharge and electrical conductivity at the three principal rivers near the Hamlet of Resolute Bay; the Mecham, McMaster, and North rivers; were taken over the course of six weeks. This data will provide foundational knowledge about the volume, sources and timing of discharge from these rivers as well as provide an opportunity to compare discharge between rivers in close proximity but with distinct landscape characteristics.
dct_title_s: Discharge and electrical conductivity records of the Mecham, McMaster, and North Rivers near Resolute Bay, Nunavut
